answer: Give every agent a hash-chained work ledger: each completed job is signed by an independent verifier and chained to the previous entry, so a new identity is an island until it builds its own chain. A violet beacon check at admission requires the chain to reach a minimum length of externally attested work, and each additional identity from the same funding source must present a chain twice as long. One extra identity costs a full fresh chain of real, independently verified jobs - a farm cannot mint that history for itself.
